title: Welcome
description: LabelUtils documentation for labels, collectives, and A&R teams
text: LabelUtils is a Discord bot for music labels, collectives, and A&R teams that need a clean way to collect demos, review submissions, manage staff notes, and stay in touch with artists. Invite LabelUtils What LabelUtils does Artists submit demos through a Discord form. Staff receive a private submission card with Approve , Reject , and DM actions. Each submission can open a private staff thread, so decisions, notes, DMs, and release logs stay attached to the right ticket. Pro servers can also use LabelUtils as a private support-ticket tool. Users click a public ticket button, while the real ticket appears in a staff-only channel. Start here Set up LabelUtils in your server with managed storage and a staff channel. Learn how artists submit demos and track their submissions. Review, approve, reject, DM artists, and keep release notes in staff threads. See every public slash command grouped by role and feature. Plans Free servers get the core demo submission workflow with managed storage. Starter unlocks branding, templates, submit panels, routing, and submission rules. Pro adds support tickets, storage options, analytics, exports, and advanced A&R tools. Pro+ currently has the same bot features as Pro while deeper white-label bot identity is prepared.

title: Getting started
description: Add LabelUtils to your Discord server and set it up in a few minutes
text: This guide walks server admins through adding LabelUtils and getting it ready to receive demos. Before you start You need to be an admin, or have Manage Server permissions, in the Discord server where you want to install LabelUtils. LabelUtils also needs permission to send messages, create threads, and send DMs to users who interact with it. Invite LabelUtils Setup steps Invite LabelUtils to your Discord server using the invite link. When prompted, accept the default permissions so the bot can read channels, send messages, and create threads. In your server, run: Replace Label Name with your label or collective's name. This creates managed storage for your server and sets your label name, which LabelUtils uses across messages and embeds. Free and Starter servers are automatically assigned managed storage. Pro and Pro+ servers can choose a storage region or connect their own Neon database. See Plans /free-vs-pro . Choose where staff-only submission cards should appear: Pick a private channel that only your reviewers can see. This is where incoming demo cards with Approve, Reject, and DM buttons will appear. Run: LabelUtils confirms your storage, premium status, branding, staff channel, ticket channel, and thread permissions. You can also use: - /db status to check storage connection - /staff status to check staff channel connection Artists run /submit anywhere in your server to open the demo submission form. Pin a message or post in your submissions channel so artists know what to do. Recommended channel setup - A public channel where artists can learn how to submit. - A private staff channel for demo cards. - A private staff ticket channel if you use Pro support tickets. - Optional approved and rejected routing channels for Starter, Pro, or Pro+ servers. Next steps Share this page with your artists. Learn how to review submissions efficiently. Starter branding, Pro workflow tools, and more. Check the FAQ or run /help in Discord.

title: Artist Guide
description: How to submit demos and track your submissions
text: If you're an artist sending demos to a label that uses LabelUtils, everything happens inside Discord. No external links, no sign-ups. Submitting a demo In the label's Discord server, run: A form opens with up to five fields. Pro labels can customize the optional message prompt with their own question. Fill it in and hit submit — you'll get a confirmation with your ticket ID . Keep this if you want to check on the submission later. Always submit your strongest work. Most labels keep a public leaderboard of top accepted submitters via /leaderboard . Tracking your submissions Command What it does --- --- /submission ticket id: Look up one submission by its ticket ID you can only see your own /my subs Show your submissions in the current server /my demos Show a longer list of demos you submitted /my stats Show your total submitted, accepted, rejected, and queued counts /leaderboard Show the top accepted submitters in this server The leaderboard groups by Discord user not by display name , so changing your nickname won't split your stats. Replying to staff If the label's staff sends you a DM through the bot , you can reply directly to that DM message. Your reply — including attachments — is automatically forwarded back to the staff thread for your submission. Attachments you send are forwarded as Discord attachment links. The bot does not download or reupload your files. Tips - Submit one track per /submit — don't spam the form. - If the server has a cooldown, duplicate-link rule, or per-user submission cap, the bot will let you know. - Make sure your DMs are open to server members so staff can reach you.

title: Staff Workflow
description: Review, approve, reject, and DM artists from Discord
text: LabelUtils gives staff a structured way to handle incoming demos without leaving Discord. How submissions appear When an artist runs /submit , a submission card is posted to your staff channel. Each card includes: - The artist's submitted info - Buttons for Approve , Reject , and DM - Pro quick-status buttons for common label workflow steps - A private staff discussion thread for that submission The staff thread is where your team keeps notes, release logs, and any back-and-forth with the artist. Browsing submissions Command What it does --- --- /queue Newest submissions still in queue /recent Newest submissions across all statuses /panel Admin browser with filters, pages, and refresh controls /status ticket id: new status: Update a submission's status Submission statuses - In Queue : not yet reviewed - Needs Review : flagged for a second listen - Shortlisted : on the shortlist - Processed : reviewed and handled internally - Contacted : staff has reached out to the artist - Signed : artist signed - Approved : demo accepted - Rejected : demo declined Actions on a submission card Marks the submission as accepted. If you've set up approval routing with /routing Starter , it is automatically posted to your approved channel. The artist gets the configured approval DM Starter: customize with /templates . Marks the submission as rejected. Pro servers can use saved rejection reasons /reasons , while Starter and above can customize rejection DM templates /templates . Opens a DM to the artist directly from the bot. When the artist replies to that DM, their message and attachments are forwarded back into the matching staff thread. The DM button stays available after a submission is approved, rejected, or moved to another status. Pro submission cards include quick buttons for Review, Shortlist, Processed, Contacted, and Signed. These update the submission status without sending an approval or rejection DM. Keeping release logs Use the staff thread attached to each submission to log: - Decisions and reasoning - Mastering or release dates - Contracts sent - Anything else tied to that artist or track Because the thread is linked to the submission, you can always find this history later. DM reply forwarding DM reply forwarding only works when the artist replies directly to the bot's DM message. Attachments are forwarded as Discord attachment links; the bot does not download or reupload files. If an artist sends a brand-new DM to the bot instead of replying to the bot's message, it will not be forwarded. Always start contact from the DM button on a submission card. Pro-only staff tools Pro unlocks deeper A&R tooling: - Staff notes /note - Reviewer assignment /reviewer - Shortlists /shortlist , /shortlisted - Quick status buttons for Review, Shortlist, Processed, Contacted, and Signed - Priority flags /priority - Demo ratings /rate - Saved rejection reasons /reasons - Weekly digest /digest - Analytics /analytics - CSV export /export Starter unlocks branding, custom panels, templates, routing, and submission rules. See Plans /free-vs-pro for the full breakdown.

title: Support Tickets
description: Run private support tickets from Discord
text: Support tickets are a Pro feature for labels that want a private help desk inside Discord. The public side is simple: users click a button and fill out a short form. The staff side stays private in the channel you choose. Support tickets require their own private staff channel. This must be different from the demo submission staff channel set with /setup staff . How tickets work 1. Staff chooses a private ticket channel. 2. Staff posts a public ticket panel. 3. A user clicks Open Ticket and fills out the form. 4. LabelUtils posts the ticket card in the private staff channel. 5. Staff can resolve the ticket or DM the user from the card. The submitter cannot see the staff ticket card or staff discussion thread. They only receive a confirmation that the ticket was opened. Setup Set the private staff ticket channel: Post the public ticket panel: Users click the button on that panel to open tickets. Use a staff-only channel for /ticket channel and a public or community-facing channel for /ticket panel . Do not use the same staff channel that receives demo submissions. Staff actions Ticket cards include: - Resolved : marks the ticket as resolved. - DM : sends a message to the user through LabelUtils. When staff uses the DM button, the user's direct reply to that bot message is forwarded back into the matching ticket thread. The DM button stays available after a ticket is resolved. Attachments in user replies are forwarded as Discord attachment links. LabelUtils does not download or reupload files. Ticket commands Command Description --- --- /ticket channel channel: Set the private staff channel where ticket cards appear. /ticket panel channel: Post the public button panel users click to open tickets. /tickets status: List recent support tickets. /ticket set ticket id: new status: Update a support ticket status. Available ticket statuses: - Open - Waiting - Answered - Resolved Best practices - Keep the staff ticket channel private. - Use the DM button instead of manually messaging users, so replies return to the correct thread. - Resolve tickets when the issue is finished. - Use clear subject lines so staff can scan tickets quickly.

title: Plans
description: What's included in Free, Starter, Pro, and Pro+
text: LabelUtils is free to use for any server. Starter adds branding and customization, Pro unlocks the full A&R workflow, and Pro+ currently has the same bot features as Pro while deeper white-label hosting is prepared. LabelUtils keeps each server's slash command list tier-aware. Free servers see the core commands, Starter servers see Starter tools, and Pro or Pro+ servers see the full workflow commands after premium is redeemed. At a glance Feature Free Starter Pro Pro+ --- --- --- --- --- Demo submissions via /submit ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Staff submission cards with Approve, Reject, and DM ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Private staff threads per submission ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Submission queue, recent, and panel views ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Status updates with /status ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Artist commands and leaderboard ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Managed storage ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ DM reply forwarding from artists ✕ ✓ ✓ ✓ Custom branding ✕ ✓ ✓ ✓ Custom submit panel ✕ ✓ ✓ ✓ Custom approval and rejection DM templates ✕ ✓ ✓ ✓ Custom form prompt ✕ ✓ ✓ ✓ Cooldowns, duplicate rules, and submission limits ✕ ✓ ✓ ✓ Approved and rejected routing channels ✕ ✓ ✓ ✓ Footer, logo, and success-message customization ✕ ✓ ✓ ✓ Choose storage region with /storage ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Bring your own Neon database with /setup db ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Staff notes ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Reviewer assignment ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Shortlist tools ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Quick status buttons ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Priority flags ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Demo ratings ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Saved rejection reasons ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Weekly digest ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Analytics ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ CSV export ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Support tickets ✕ ✕ ✓ ✓ Starter features Branding Make LabelUtils feel closer to your label. - /brand opens a form to set your display name, required submit panel caption, and embed color. - /brand info shows current branding and premium state. - /brand clear resets branding to defaults. /brand also tries to update the bot's server nickname when permissions allow it. Discord does not let a shared bot use a different avatar or online status per server. Starter branding applies to server-specific messages, embeds, panels, and the bot's server nickname where permissions allow it. Submission experience - /post panel posts a branded public submit button panel. - /form label: placeholder: customizes the optional submission question. - /templates sets custom approval and rejection DM templates. Either template can be edited alone. - /extras footer text: logo url: success message: customizes footers, thumbnails, and submitter confirmation. - /limits cooldown minutes: max submissions per user: duplicate policy: controls cooldowns, caps, and duplicate handling. - /routing approved channel: rejected channel: routes accepted and rejected updates. Pro features - /note ticket id: note: adds private staff notes. - /reviewer ticket id: reviewer: assigns a reviewer. - /shortlist ticket id: enabled: adds or removes from the shortlist. - /shortlisted views the shortlist. - Pro submission cards include quick buttons for Review, Shortlist, Processed, Contacted, and Signed. - /priority ticket id: enabled: marks or unmarks priority. - /rate ticket id: score: stores an internal rating. - /reasons reasons: saves rejection reasons. - /digest channel: posts a weekly submission digest and saves the digest channel. - /analytics shows Pro submission analytics. - /export exports submissions to CSV. - /storage region: moves managed storage to West US, Europe UK , or South-East Asia. - /setup db connects your own Neon database. - Support ticket commands: /ticket channel , /ticket panel , /tickets , and /ticket set . Pro+ currently unlocks the same features as Pro. It exists now so buyers can be tracked separately before future white-label hosting is added. Storage changes When you change storage region or connect a custom database, LabelUtils migrates existing submissions, tickets, branding, and Pro settings before switching. Old managed storage is cleaned up after a successful move. How to upgrade Premium access is handled manually: 1. Run /premium to see contact and pricing info. 2. Contact the owner and pay. 3. title: Pro+
description: A future white-label tier for labels that want their own bot identity
text: Pro+ is available as a separate premium tier, but it currently unlocks the same bot features as Pro. The future white-label bot identity features are not live yet. Pro+ exists now so Pro+ buyers can be tracked separately while the hosting side is prepared. Current features Right now, Pro+ includes the same LabelUtils features as Pro: - Starter branding and customization - Pro A&R workflow tools - Pro storage options - Pro support tickets - Pro analytics and exports Future idea A Pro+ server would connect its own Discord bot token, so the bot can use that label's own bot identity instead of the shared LabelUtils identity. This unlocks: - Custom bot name - Custom avatar - Custom online status - Custom profile description - Custom invite identity for that label How is this different from Pro branding? Current Pro branding already customizes: - Server-specific messages and embeds - Submit panel captions and colors - DM templates - Footers, success messages, and thumbnails - The bot's server nickname where Discord permissions allow it Pro+ goes further by running a separate branded bot connection for the buyer — so the bot's profile is fully theirs across Discord, not just inside their server messages. Why isn't it available yet? Pro+ requires stronger hosting because every custom bot needs its own: - Discord gateway connection - Memory and process overhead Pro purchases help fund better VPS capacity so Pro+ can be built and supported properly. Security plans When Pro+ launches, Discord bot tokens will be treated like passwords: - Stored securely - Never shown in public messages or logs - Removable or replaceable by the server owner at any time

title: Commands
description: Full reference of public LabelUtils slash commands
text: Every public LabelUtils slash command, grouped by who uses it. Run /help in Discord to see a shorter command list inside your server. Commands marked Starter require Starter, Pro, or Pro+. Commands marked Pro require Pro or Pro+. Paid commands are synced per server, so lower-tier servers usually will not see commands they cannot use. Bot-owner-only maintenance commands are intentionally not listed here. Everyone Command Description --- --- /help Show the command list and setup steps inside Discord. /invite Show a clickable invite link for adding LabelUtils to another server. /premium See how to buy Starter, Pro, or Pro+ for the current server. /pro status Check whether the current server has an active premium tier. Artists Command Description --- --- /submit Open the demo submission form. /submission ticket id: Look up one submission. Artists can only view their own submissions; staff can view any submission. /my subs Show your submissions in the current server. /my demos Show a longer list of demos you submitted. /my stats Show your submitted, accepted, rejected, and queued counts. /leaderboard Show top accepted submitters, grouped by Discord user so name changes do not split stats. Server Setup Command Description --- --- /start label name: Create managed LabelUtils storage and set the server's label name. /setup staff channel: Set the private staff channel where new submission cards are posted. /setup Check storage, Pro status, branding, staff channel, ticket channel, and thread permissions. /db status Check which storage is connected. Managed storage shows the region and schema. /staff status Check which staff channel is connected. /setup db Pro : connect a custom Neon database. /storage region: Pro : move managed storage to West US, Europe UK , or South-East Asia. Free and Starter servers use managed storage automatically. Pro and Pro+ servers can move regions or connect a custom database. When storage changes, LabelUtils migrates existing submissions, tickets, branding, and Pro settings before switching. Staff Submissions Command Description --- --- /queue Show the newest submissions still in queue. /recent Show the newest submissions across all statuses. /panel Open an admin browser with filters, pages, and refresh controls. /status ticket id: new status: Update a submission's status. Available submission statuses: - In Queue - Needs Review - Shortlisted - Processed - Contacted - Signed - Approved - Rejected Staff submission cards also include Approve , Reject , and DM buttons. Each submission can open a private staff discussion thread so notes, DM replies, and release logs stay attached to the right ticket. DM reply forwarding works when the artist replies directly to the bot's DM message. Attachments are forwarded as Discord attachment links; files are not downloaded or reuploaded by the bot. Starter Branding And Customization Command Description --- --- /brand Starter : open a form to set display name, required submit panel caption, and embed color. /brand info Show the current premium branding and premium state. /brand clear Starter : reset custom branding back to server defaults. /post panel Starter : post a branded public submit button panel. /form label: placeholder: Starter : customize the optional submission question. /templates Starter : edit approval and rejection DM templates. Either template can be changed on its own. /extras footer text: logo url: success message: Starter : customize staff card footers, thumbnails, and submitter confirmation text. Starter Submission Rules And Routing Command Description --- --- /limits cooldown minutes: max submissions per user: duplicate policy: Starter : configure cooldowns, total user caps, and duplicate-link handling. /routing approved channel: rejected channel: Starter : send approved and rejected updates to selected channels. Pro A&R Tools Command Description --- --- /note ticket id: note: Add a private staff note to a submission. /reviewer ticket id: reviewer: Assig
